feeds.title: Department of Land and Natural Resources
feeds.description: Read News releases, reports, and archives from The Department of Land and Natural Resources. Headed by an Executive Board of Land and Natural Resources, DLNR is responsible for managing, administering, and exercising control over public lands, water resources, ocean waters, coastal areas, and minerals.

feeds.title: Winston County Natural Resources Council
feeds.description: The Winston County Natural Resources Council's blog covers topics such as soil and water, hiking, and forest resources and also official updates, and meetings from the council. Winston County Smith Lake Advocacy, Inc., is a non-profit corporation, which organizes Lewis Smith Lake cleanups, and school initiatives to promote greater understanding of human impact on lake waters.

feeds.title: Resource Insights
feeds.description: Resource Insights by Kurt cobb covers independent commentary on Environmental and Natural resource news. Kurt Cobb is a freelance writer and communications consultant who writes frequently about energy and the environment. He is also the author of an oil-themed novel entitled Prelude.

feeds.title: Vermont Natural Resources Council
feeds.description: Read News and stories about the latest Environmental and Climate-related developments here at VNRC. VNRC is a non-profit that aims to protect and enhances Vermont's natural environments, vibrant communities, rural character and unique sense of place, and prepares the state for future challenges and opportunities.

feeds.title: PHS Natural Resources
feeds.description: Dive deep into topics such as Case study, Intro unit, Labs, Science and society, and Soils. PHS Natural Resources by Mr. Bledsoe is an educational blog that provides online resources and ideas about Energy, Natural Resources, Geography, Climate, and more.

feeds.title: The Energy Law Blog » Energy & Natural Resources
feeds.description: Discover articles that provide insights and analysis of legal issues impacting the Energy Industry, Natural Resources, and other topics at the Energy Law Blog by Liskow & Lewis. We are a recognized law firm assisting clients engaged in virtually every facet of energy, including exploration, production, marketing, financing, and transportation.

feeds.title: Holland & Knight Blog » Energy and Natural Resources
feeds.description: The Holland & Knight Energy and Natural Resources Blog features news and analysis related to energy and natural resource litigation and regulation. Explore posts from Energy, Oil& Gas, Mining, and other topics. Holland & Knight is an Energy Law firm that serves clients globally with a mission to provide seamless, efficient client-centric services over a wide range of industries.

feeds.title: FNR Purdue Extension » Natural Resource Planning
feeds.description: The Got Nature? blog shares updates, research and resources by Forest and Natural Resources. The Purdue Extension-Forestry and Natural Resources is a great source of environmental information. We provide resources for aquaculture, fish management, urban and forestry management, natural resource planning, wildlife, and sustainable biomaterials.

feeds.title: Natural Resources Foundation of Wisconsin Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is where we share the stories about our impact on Wisconsin's lands and waters, wildlife, and people. The Natural Resources Foundation of Wisconsin is a nonprofit that was formed in 1986. With the support of our donors and members, the Foundation has boosted private sector investment and involvement in Wisconsin's lands, waters, and wildlife.

feeds.title: ISU Blog » Natural Resource
feeds.description: The Natural resources extension of the Iowa State University blog shares well-written posts on Iowa's wildlife, habitats, water quality, and many other natural significant factors. The ISU Extension and Outreach serves all Iowans. We are educators, researchers, volunteers, and partners in Ames and throughout the state.

feeds.title: Natural Resources and Mining Law Blog
feeds.description: JMBM's Natural Resources and Mining Law Blog covers articles on Natural Resources & Mining, Legislation, Mining News, Litigation, Water, CEQA, and Land use. JMBM is a full-service law firm that provides companies and trade associations with counseling, compliance, transactions, and litigation services in every area of federal and California natural resources and mining law.

feeds.title: UF IFAS » Natural Resources
feeds.description: The Natural Resources category of our blog expands upon what we know of our local resources, benefits, threats, and efforts being made to conserve those resources. The UF/IFAS is a federal-state-county partnership dedicated to developing knowledge in agriculture, human and natural resources, and the life sciences.

feeds.title: Natural Resources Council of Maine Blog
feeds.description: NRCM's Nature of Maine blog gives you the inside scoop on some of the latest issues facing Maine's environment. Get the latest everything from environmental news to threats to opportunities in Maine. The Natural Resources Council of Maine is a nonprofit membership organization protecting, restoring, and conserving Maine's environment, now and for future generations.

feeds.title: UC ANR » Green Blog
feeds.description: The ANR's Green Blog reports enironment and climate-related news from the UC Division of Agriculture and Natural Resources. UC Agriculture and Natural Resources connects the power of UC research in agriculture, natural resources, nutrition and youth development with local communities to improve the lives of Californian people.

feeds.title: Berkshire Natural Resources Council Blog
feeds.description: Dive into the Landkeeper's blog for an interesting account of walks and trails through the natural resources of Berkshire. The Berkshire Natural Resources Council has been preserving and keeping land in the Berkshires for 50 years. We exist to protect and preserve the natural beauty and ecological integrity of the Berkshires for public benefit and enjoyment.
